The '''''Heraklon''-class transport''' was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-type [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was widely used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Dark Wars]]. Typically used as a cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], its versatility allowed for a broad use as a [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] especially in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

In [[3951 BBY]], the sales reputation of the ''Heraklon''-class transport sank, as [[Zhug Ship|one]] of the ships was shot down above [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] amid the [[Onderon Civil War]] and crashed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. However, changes in the ship's advertising to a focus on safety in case of an accident guaranteed the continued production of the ''Heraklon''-class.

==Characteristics==
The ''Heraklon''-class [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-type transport [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. As it was easy to use and very versatile, it saw use in a number of different functions. It had a simple construct, leaving the entire front part of the ship for crew quarters and cargo, and placing the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] section and ship systems in the narrow tail. The cargo holds took up the majority of space inside the transport, and they could be modified to carry specialized cargoes of livestock. The passenger accommodation could also be modified to carry 450 people with three-tier bunk rooms, or just 150 in luxury rooms. A number of ''Heraklon''-class transports were even purchased by various travel companies for use as [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]]. ''Heraklon''-class transports were built without any weapon systems fitted, so as to reduce production costs. This forced [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] to avoid traveling outside of secure [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] typically found near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], traveling in larger groups and thus essentially forming a [[caravan]], or to hire an armed escort to provide security against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other outlaws.<ref name="message" />

==Role==
Due the versatility of the ''Heraklon''-class transport ships, they saw a wide range of use. In [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], most typically these ships were used as cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. In the Core Worlds and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], they usually were configured to carry passengers as a liner or even as a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. The ''Heraklon''-class transports also saw use in the hands of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and pirates, who benefited from the myriad of pockets that could be found in the ship. Pirates often modified the central section of the ship to have concealed [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] for small [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] so as to ambush unsuspecting merchant vessels traveling too close to the pirates' claimed territory.<ref name="message" />

==History==
[[File:IfYouSquintYouCanSeeStarships-KOTOR2.jpg|thumb|left|220px|''Heraklon''-class transport ships over Onderon in 3951 BBY]]
The ''Heraklon''-class transport was built by [[Sadon Shipwrights]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Dark Wars]] and was an updated version of the [[Dionad-class transport|''Dionad''-class transport]]. Sales were initially quite high, and ''Heraklon''-class transports became more popular than similar transports that were used by Sadon's rivals.<ref name="message" />

However, in [[3951 BBY]], the ''Heraklon''-class transport gained some negative publicity, due to the actions of the [[Zhug brothers]], a group of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The Zhug brothers acquired a [[Zhug Ship|''Heraklon''-class ship]] for their personal use and with it attempted to land in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. However, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]] of the [[Onderonian military]] had [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the world due to the [[Onderon Civil War]] and prevented the Zhugs from landing by shooting their ship, thus forcing them to crash on Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="message" /><ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

As a result of the incident, sales of ''Heraklon''-class transports decreased and some of Sadon's executives began considering developing an alternative design of transport to replace the ''Heraklon''-class. However, the ''Heraklon''-class was saved by a change in Sadon's advertising strategies; the focus centered on how the passengers and cargo of a ''Heraklon''-class transport would be safe in the event of an accident. The campaign worked and sales returned to a profitable level, ensuring the continued production of the ''Heraklon''-class.<ref name="message" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Heraklon''-class transport was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]] at the end of [[2004]]. Several ships of this class were briefly seen in the cutscene when arriving on Onderon, waiting to be let through the blockade. It also appeared as unnamed wreckage of the Zhug brothers on the surface of Dxun.<ref name="kotor2" /> Although no name is shown in the game, the game model of the wreckage is labeled as "Zhug Ship" in dialog file.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' dialogue file, StrRef 87291</ref>

The ''Heraklon''-class transport ship first received its [[canon]] name alongside the technical description and history of the model in "[[Message to Spacers]] 9", an article written by [[Patrick Stutzman]] and released in [[2010]] as an online supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The article also contained details of the events that led to the Zhug brothers crash-landing on Dxun, identifying that the damage had been caused by [[Onderon separatists]] forces under Colonel Tobin's command.<ref name="message" />
